docs.summary: Assets imported from source files as they are needed, the runtime counterpart of the editor's importers: point it at a folder, a zip or a web server and [`Mount`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.AssetDatabase~Mount) it. Every file a [`RuntimeImporter`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.RuntimeImporter) knows is findable by its path without the extension, "Textures/Paint" for "Textures/Paint.png", and its sub assets at "path#name" once the file has been loaded. GUIDs come from the source's name and the path, so they are the same every run.
Lists the source's files again, for files added or removed since it was mounted.
